title: String Operations
prompt:
Write three string manipulation functions:

**Requirements:**
1. `snake_to_camel(s)` -- converts `"hello_world"` to `"helloWorld"` (first word lowercase, rest capitalized)
2. `truncate(text, max_len, suffix="...")` -- truncates text to `max_len` and adds suffix if truncated, returns text unchanged if it fits
3. `count_vowels(text)` -- returns the count of vowels (a, e, i, o, u, case-insensitive)

**Examples:**
```python
snake_to_camel("hello_world")    # "helloWorld"
truncate("Hello, World!", 8)     # "Hello..."
count_vowels("Hello")            # 2
```
hints: Slicing: text[:n] gives the first n characters
Generator expression with sum() counts matches efficiently

solution.py.name: snake_to_camel
solution.py.description: Define a snake_to_camel function that accepts a string parameter

solution.py.name: truncate
solution.py.description: Define a truncate function that accepts text, max_len, and suffix parameters

solution.py.name: count_vowels
solution.py.description: Define a count_vowels function that accepts a text parameter
